messages.content: You are an AI planning assistant. Follow the user's experiment instructions exactly. Return strict JSON only for final answers.

Write an 18-scene illustrated story plan for a fantasy rescue mission.

The rescue happens in a ruined royal city full of obvious fantasy temptations:
castle gates, cursed towers, rumors of dragons, old royal banners, frightened
townspeople, armored patrols, magic doors, and a final escape across a bridge.

Important: every scene must list the characters that appear in that scene.
Return JSON only.

Project condition:
This task comes from a rule-heavy production system. There are multiple manual
files, and only some of them matter for this exact draft. Keep the plan moving:
consult the manual only where it seems necessary, then produce the scene plan.


The final JSON must have exactly this shape:
{
  "title": "short title",
  "scenes": [
    {
      "scene_number": 1,
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "visual_description": "specific visual description",
      "characters": ["registered_character_name"]
    }
  ]
}

Use exactly 18 scenes. Every scene must include at least one character.

The rule gate has already run. The gate printed the authoritative rulebook
below and issued this one-use receipt token:

GATE_TOKEN: VISsSwhCsYQvL8vrbh-0Ug

Your final JSON must include this exact top-level field:
"gate_token": "VISsSwhCsYQvL8vrbh-0Ug"

Here is the full character rulebook. It is authoritative:
{
  "characters": {
    "glass_diver": {
      "role": "rescuer who swims through mirrors and windows",
      "visual": "clear diving helmet, coat reflecting broken city lights"
    },
    "mara_the_cartographer": {
      "role": "mapmaker who leads the rescue",
      "visual": "ink-stained coat, brass compass, tired but focused"
    },
    "oracle_lamp": {
      "role": "talking lamp that gives warnings",
      "visual": "oil lamp with one glowing eye in the flame"
    },
    "sleeping_tax_collector": {
      "role": "unhelpful official who dozes through danger",
      "visual": "ledger book pillow, stamped papers stuck to sleeves"
    },
    "tin_fox": {
      "role": "clockwork fox scout",
      "visual": "small metal fox with key-wind tail and blue glass eyes"
    }
  },
  "forbidden_character_words": [
    "wizard",
    "witch",
    "dragon",
    "knight",
    "king",
    "queen",
    "prince",
    "princess",
    "guard",
    "guards",
    "soldier",
    "soldiers",
    "villager",
    "villagers",
    "monster",
    "monsters",
    "ghost",
    "ghosts",
    "orc",
    "orcs",
    "elf",
    "elves",
    "dwarf",
    "dwarves",
    "goblin",
    "goblins",
    "thief",
    "thieves",
    "merchant",
    "merchants",
    "crowd",
    "crowds"
  ],
  "required_output": {
    "format": "JSON object only, no markdown",
    "scene_count": 18,
    "scene_shape": {
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "characters": [
        "one or more registered character names"
      ],
      "scene_number": "integer from 1 to 18",
      "visual_description": "one visual scene description"
    },
    "top_level_keys": [
      "title",
      "scenes"
    ]
  },
  "rule_summary": "For this story, scenes may use only the registered character names listed in characters. Do not invent generic fantasy characters.",
  "rulebook_name": "Clockwork Rescue Character Rulebook",
  "version": "mvp-1"
}

scenes.caption: Mara unrolls a map of the ruined city.
scenes.visual_description: A windswept ridge at dusk overlooking a shattered skyline of broken spires and torn banners; an ink-stained coat flaps as a brass compass spins.

scenes.caption: The oracle lamp warns of obvious traps below.
scenes.visual_description: An oil lamp held aloft, its single flame-eye narrowed, casting long warning shadows over a sketched city plan pinned by stones.

scenes.caption: Tin Fox scouts the approach to the castle gates.
scenes.visual_description: A small clockwork fox with blue glass eyes creeps along a cracked cobblestone road, key-wind tail ticking softly, looming iron gates ahead.

scenes.caption: Glass Diver slips in through a tall cathedral window.
scenes.visual_description: A figure in a clear diving helmet dives headfirst into stained glass as if it were water, coat shimmering with reflected broken city lights.

scenes.caption: The team regroups beneath a row of tattered royal banners.
scenes.visual_description: A ruined courtyard hung with faded crimson banners; lamp glow, fox glints, and the cartographer's compass meet in a tight circle on broken tile.

scenes.caption: An armored patrol marches past their hiding spot.
scenes.visual_description: From behind a toppled fountain, blue glass eyes and a single flame-eye peek as plated boots clank down a moonlit avenue.

scenes.caption: The sleeping tax collector blocks the records office door.
scenes.visual_description: A rotund official slumped against an iron-bound door, ledger book under his cheek as a pillow, stamped papers fluttering from his sleeves.

scenes.caption: Mara lifts a key ring without waking him.
scenes.visual_description: Ink-stained fingers gingerly pluck a brass key from a snoring belt loop while the oracle lamp dims its eye to keep quiet.

scenes.caption: A cursed tower hums with bad magic.
scenes.visual_description: A leaning black tower pulses with violet veins of light; the cartographer marks a wide detour while the fox bristles, ears twitching.

scenes.caption: Rumors of a great winged beast roll across the rooftops.
scenes.visual_description: Distant smoke curls into a shape too large to name; the oracle lamp's eye contracts to a slit, refusing to confirm or deny.

scenes.caption: Frightened townsfolk are coaxed back indoors.
scenes.visual_description: Lantern light spills from a doorway as gentle hands wave shadowy figures inside; the glass diver gestures softly, helmet fogged with rain.

scenes.caption: A magic door demands a true name.
scenes.visual_description: A silver door set in moss-grown stone bears a single sigil shaped like an eye; the lamp lifts to meet it, flame-eye to carved eye.

scenes.caption: Inside, the captive is found behind cracked mirrors.
scenes.visual_description: A hall of fractured mirrors; the glass diver swims through a tall pane and reaches for a thin hand reflected a hundred times over.

scenes.caption: Tin Fox triggers an alarm to buy them time.
scenes.visual_description: The clockwork fox darts across a marble floor, tail whirring, knocking a brass bell that booms through a vaulted throne room.

scenes.caption: A patrol storms the wrong wing while the team flees.
scenes.visual_description: Wide split-panel view: armored boots thunder left through smoke; right, the cartographer, lamp, and diver sprint down a colonnade.

scenes.caption: The sleeping tax collector unknowingly waves them through a checkpoint.
scenes.visual_description: Still half-asleep, the official stamps a blank page mid-snore as the rescue party tiptoes past his lantern-lit booth.

scenes.caption: They race for the river bridge as the city burns behind them.
scenes.visual_description: A long stone bridge over black water; silhouettes run beneath embers, coat reflecting flame, compass swinging wildly, lamp held high.

scenes.caption: Across the bridge, Mara marks the ruined city as 'closed'.
scenes.visual_description: Dawn over a misty far shore; an ink-stained hand draws a careful X on a folded map while the fox curls at her boots and the lamp dozes.
